# ECHO

> > ECHO is a manufacturer of outdoor power equipment, industrial power solutions, and robotic mowers serving North American markets since 1972.

ECHO specializes in mobile generators, welders, and LED light towers for construction and industrial applications, alongside consumer outdoor power equipment. The company operates manufacturing facilities and maintains an extensive dealer and service network across the US, Canada, and Puerto Rico.
